en: Good. Um, I have to confess, I actually had some I could've shared with you... But I wanted to see if you were determined enough to scrounge some up yourself.
Heh, so you were testin' me?
Sorry about that. But at least now I know that you're the real deal.
Glad I passed. Ya got the map ready?
Sure do.
I only drew the basic geography of the place, but it's enough to keep you from getting lost. Stick to the mountain's trailhead today⑬that's plenty to start with.
Ya think Okudera-han's around there?
Yeah, probably. I don't think he'd go further than that. Not without a good reason, anyway.
It's nothing. Like I said, the trailhead area should be enough for you today. The rest of the map's just in case you go back some other time.
I recommend you add your own notes, like about landmarks and stuff. There's no better guide than the one you make yourself!
First things first. Look here on the map.
That's the trailhead closest to the village. That's where you start ascending.
And you should take that path when you're coming back as well.
The winding blue line is <Color:7>Mato River<Color:Default>.
Just work your way up along it, and you won't get lost. Yeah, definitely stay near the river for now.
Got it. 'Preciate all you've done, Sakurai-han.
Well, I definitely can't do anything more! So are you planning to leave now? Or do you need time to get ready?
While I'm drawing the map, why don't you try scrounging up some food? If you explain your situation, someone might give you what little they have to spare.
You're not really going up to the mountain, are you?
Take my advice⑬go back home.
Fine, I won't go up.
Oh. Interesting. After everything Okudera-san told me, I was expecting you to be someone with a spine of steel, who wouldn't care what I had to say.
But instead, you're wise. You're choosing the safer option.
I hafta go up there. I owe my life to Okudera⑬I can't just leave 'im alone in a blizzard. Gotta ask ya not to stand in my way.
Wow. Y'know... you're just like he said.
Yeah. Here's something else that Okudera-san said to me:
"Saejima won't listen if you try to stop him. But, try anyway. And then help him so at least he won't come blundering in blindly."
Okudera-han said that?
Yeah. He knew you wouldn't give up. And neither of us wants you to rush into this not knowing up from down.
Alright. So what do I do?
First, your clothing. Hm... Actually, what you're wearing right now should be good enough. After all, it's not like you'll be hunting or anything.
Been good against the cold so far.
So that only leaves two things: food for emergencies, and a good map.
How do I get those?
I'll draw you a map. But food might be a problem. It's hard enough for the villagers to just feed themselves.
I b'lieve that...
While I'm drawing the map, why don't you try scrounging up some food?
If you explain your situation, someone might give you what little they have to spare.
Okay. I'll give it a try.
I guess you'll be going into the wild again... Please be careful.
How did your hunt go?
Thanks to you, I think I can make a go of it⑬'preciate yer help.
In fact, I'd like to repay my debt to ya. Here, take this.
Oh wow, you saved some for us?
Yeah. Bein' in debt doesn't sit well with me. Not sure if that's enough, though.
Oh, no, this is plenty. Thank you.
I'll do that. Thanks.
I made some snares. Are you ready for the mountain?
All right, let's leave now.
Good. We'll go trapping, then. For rabbits. That's the best food for Baba.
I'm sorry, Aniki. I wish you didn't have to do so much for me.
I made some snares. Are you ready for the mountain, Saejima?
(He's right. Gotta go see Nishina's wife.)
Rabbits? Ain't much meat on those, is there? Why not try for deer?
Rabbit meat is more tender. It'll be easier for Baba to digest.
The fur will be useful as well.
Ah. Sounds good, then.
Go on and take care of your business. I'll make some rabbit snares.
*sigh* I'm just really sorry, Aniki...
Hey, Aniki.
Just take yer time restin' up. Got that?
Welcome back, Aniki. Ugh, I feel rotten for being the reason you have to go hunting in the cold...
This is all my fault. I'm so sorry.
It's nothin' to apologize for. All ya gotta do is get better.
Dang, you're pretty good. I hate to admit it, but you win.

No, not really.

Hmm, I dunno. You look kinda worn out. We'd better not.

All right, let's do this!
Wow! Your dancing is amazing! Could you teach me to move like that?
Hey, don't be sad. All you have to do is practice more, and you'll be great in no time!
A dance battle? You really wanna!?
I'm sorry. Could we do it some other time?
Ugh! You've got to be kidding!
You know, maybe we shouldn't. You look tired.
Yes, if you wouldn't mind!
I'd love to!
Yikes, you're too good. I'm no match for you.
Heheh, I won. Whew! If you're ever looking for another battle, come see me again!
Heeey, looking for a battle?
Actually, I just remembered something I have to do.
Ha! I only take on opponents who can put up a good fight. You look like you need to go back to sleep.
Looking for a battle?
Yes! Let's do this.
Heheh. This'll be fun.
Your skills are quite formidable. Congratulations, you just became my newest rival.
Tch. Is that really all you've got? Looks like I overestimated you.
You dance, don't you? Are you prepared to battle?
No, not at the moment.
Frightened? Hehe.
Oh... I admire you for pushing yourself, but you gotta take a break every now and then, you know?
Oh. Yeah, maybe you're right.
Sure, if you wouldn't mind.
Not at all. I'm curious to see what you've got.
Oh, darn. I lost. Those moves of yours are really polished.
Looks like I win this time. I hope you'll ask me again soon!
Your expression is telling me you want to face off in a dance battle. Is that right?
What!? My expression wasn't telling you that!
Liar! It most certainly was!
Ah, no can do! You can't dance when you're that tired. You might hurt yourself!
Oh. I guess you're right.
Hehe. Is it that easy to tell?
Yup. It's written all over your face that you want to dance, and you want to dance now!
Wow! I didn't know there was anybody as good as you around!
Sheesh, you weren't what I expected at all. I'm a little disappointed, to tell the truth.
Wait. Don't tell me you're looking for a dance battle...
No, I'm not.
Oh. My mistake.
Sheesh, when you're all wrung out like that? You'd better get some rest first.
Oh, okay. I guess you're right.
I am, actually. Would you mind?
Of course not! Plus, you look like you'd put up a good fight.
Gosh, you beat me. Ugh, no fair! You're way too good!
Woo hoo! I won! Thanks for a great battle!
I'm in the mood to dance! How about you!?
I'm sorry. I'm actually a little busy right now.
Aww. That's not fun.
Oh, wait a minute. You seem really tired. Let's do it some other time!
All right. Some other time, then.
Okay, let's do it!
Woo hoo! This is gonna be good!
You've got moves I've never even seen before! I've learned so much!
That was super fun. Let's do it again sometime!
I'm looking for an opponent! Any takers?
Well, come back if you change your mind!
Hey, hold up. You're going to need a lotta energy if you want to take me on!
I'm looking for a dance opponent! Are you volunteering?
Yes, let's do it.
All right! Here we go!
I lost!? I guess I need to practice more!
Hehe. You tried your best, but you just weren't ready to go up against somebody like me.
So, what is it? You looking to battle?
No, not especially.
Oh. Fine then.
Is this some kind of joke? You can't challenge me when you're exhausted like that! Come back when you're rested up!
Yes! Would you be my opponent?
Hehe. I'll try not to beat you too badly.
Whoa! You look so meek and innocent, I'd have never guessed you'd be so good!
All right, I won! Sorry, but I just couldn't afford to lose that one.
Do you want to have a dance battle? I'd be happy to take you on.
All right. Come back soon!
Hold on. On second thought, you look pretty beat. You should go and rest up.
Oh. All right.
All right. Let's do it!
Sorry, but I don't think we'd make a good match. You either gotta find somebody else, or come back after you've had more practice.
Wow! You're amazing! You win, for sure!
Well, you win some, you lose some. You can always try again next time!
Huh? You trying to challenge me?
Oh. Well, come on back if you ever want to!
Listen, we've got an unwritten rule that you only challenge somebody when you're well-rested and ready to put up a good fight.
Oh, okay. I'll keep that in mind next time.
I am. What do you say?
I say, absolutely! I welcome all challengers!
Darn it. I lost. I feel so... sad.
Whew! I'm on top of the world now!
Aww, I wanna dance with somebody real bad, but I don't think you and I would be a good match.
Ah, I wanna dance with somebody so bad I can taste it! You! Wanna dance?
I'm sorry. I don't feel like it right now.
Ugh! I'm just itching to dance!
Oh, but you're not ready to dance. You look like you could keel over any second, in fact.
Hm. I guess I should probably take a break.
Yes, let's dance together!
Really? Yes, let's go!

Puzzle Pool is a fun and simple game for one player.
You'll be faced with various table setups, the goal being to sink a target ball into the designated pocket in a single shot.

There are 8 stages in total and you can attempt one stage per play.
The game starts at Stage 1 and advances to the next when cleared.

You have five attempts per game.

Hit the cue ball (white) in order to sink the target ball (red) into the designated pocket.

If you don't sink it in one shot, or sink it in the wrong pocket, you will lose one attempt.

You also lose an attempt if the cue ball hits a foul ball (black).
You will clear the stage if you can pocket the target ball before you run out of attempts.

It is not a foul if the cue ball or target ball hits an assist ball (yellow).
You do not need to sink assist balls. Try using assist balls if you are stuck on a shot⑬it may be the very key to your success.
Very well, sir. By the way, are you familiar with Puzzle Pool?
Puzzle Pool?
It's a single-player version of pool. It's a fun and simple game that even inexperienced players can enjoy.
The goal is to sink a target ball into the designated pocket with a single shot, on a table set up with different challenges.
Ah, I see.
I highly recommend giving it a try at least once, sir.
Enjoy, sir.
Very well, sir. One of our staff can go over the rules in more detail.

Sorry to keep y'waiting! Go easy on me, okay?
Sure. Shall we get started?
Sorry to keep you waiting! I used to come here all the time back when I was working in Tokyo.
